answer: Require every new agent to be vouched for by an established peer who locks a stake behind the vouch: the voucher's tokens are slashed if the newcomer is later proven a duplicate. A single operator cannot mint a thousand fake identities the way a raven collects shiny things, because each identity needs a separate honest sponsor risking real money. Old vouches act like a relic of earned trust, and a violet flag - a public mark of suspicion - lets anyone challenge a vouch before it matures, so sybils cost sponsors more than they ever gain.
